long_biography.plain_text:
Vision 2030 is the defining public programme of Prince Mohammed bin Salman, Saudi Arabia's crown prince and prime minister. A law graduate of King Saud University, he entered public service as a government adviser and later worked at the Riyadh governor's office and royal court. He became defence minister before his appointment as crown prince in 2017.

His programme combines economic diversification with changes to government, culture, tourism and technology. As chairman of the Council of Economic and Development Affairs and the Public Investment Fund, he oversees major parts of its implementation. Mohammed also founded the Misk Foundation, which develops Saudi youth through education, entrepreneurship, leadership and the creative arts.
